_comment: Stage 4: additional UCI datasets with the same protocol, scaled: T = 1,000,000 rounds, labels shifted every 200,000 rounds (4 drifts), 10 seeds. Run once per dataset with --data pendigits / letter / shuttle. NB settings are the paper's (not re-tuned); EXP3.S alpha = 1/T = 1e-6; baselines are tuned per dataset (tuning.json with --data <name> --set T=400000 period=200000).
